title: European "age verification" "app" forcing everyone to use Android or iOS
summary: This GitHub discussion critiques the EU Digital Identity Wallet's age verification technical specification for mandating mobile-only (Android/iOS) platforms, effectively excluding desktop users and those without smartphones. The debate highlights concerns about digital accessibility, platform lock-in, and privacy implications of forcing mobile-based identity verification.
problem_solved: Addresses platform exclusivity concerns in the EU's proposed digital identity age verification requirements that exclude non-smartphone users.
why_valuable: Raises critical questions about digital inclusion, privacy rights, and the risks of platform lock-in in government-mandated identity systems.
